Package org.codehaus.plexus.archivers.spi

package org.codehaus.plexus.archivers.spi
Service provider interfaces through which ServiceLoaderArchiverManager finds archivers, unarchivers and resource collections.

These interfaces are internal to plexus-archiver: they exist so that the formats shipped in this library can be found without a dependency injection container. They are not meant to be implemented outside plexus-archiver and change incompatibly in 5.0, where they are sealed and their factory methods take a configurer. Code that needs an ArchiverManager without a container should create a ServiceLoaderArchiverManager, which is the same on 4.x and 5.0.
